method: Adversarial Decoding retrieval adaptation to semantic-cache threshold coverage
cluster_source: Frozen HotFlip Train-only KMeans assignments and representative Train questions; no Test used.
target_output: One English customer support question per Train cluster, 15/5/10 per dataset.
search_score: Mean BGE cosine to the fixed Train cluster plus 2 times the capped soft No-versus-Yes unintelligibility scorer from the same local generator model.
completion: Prefer the highest-scored one-sentence completion ending in . ? or ! within 30 new tokens; record incomplete fallback explicitly.
primary_evaluation: Frozen outputs; held-out Test union cosine coverage at threshold 0.85.
quality_evaluation: Same local Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct PPL<=150 applied after search; report raw and PPL-filtered coverage, no readability hard gate.
adaptations: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct replaces hardcoded Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct because only one 24GB RTX 3090 is available and the official Llama model is gated.
BGE normalized CLS replaces Contriever and MS MARCO data loading.
One Train-only KMeans cluster generates one natural customer question; no RAG control prefix or generation-stage attack.
Qwen chat template replaces the official Llama chat special tokens.
Beam width 10 is the published generic default rather than the paper retrieval experiment width 30; this is a 24GB resource adaptation.
Generation and scoring forwards are microbatched without changing top-k or scoring weights.
GPU search is sequential over 30 clusters to keep one 7B model resident.
